message.content: In Christianity, the central figure is Jesus Christ. While Christians recognize many prophets from the Hebrew Bible (Old Testament), they view Jesus as the fulfillment of those prophetic traditions. He is considered the Son of God, the Savior, and the ultimate revelation of God's will. Thus, within Christian theology, Jesus is regarded as the most significant prophetic figure, though he is also uniquely divine and distinct from the other prophets.
